title.narrative: Conserving Greater Virunga - Annual narrative report 2023

description.narrative: The management of protected areas listed in appendix 1 of GVTC treaty namely Volcanoes NP in Rwanda; Virunga NP & Sarambwe Wildlife Reserve in DRC and Mgahinga Gorilla NP, Queen Elizabeth NP, Bwindi NP, Rwenzori Mountain NP, and Semliki NP in Uganda; The communities in the Greater Virunga landscape and The GVTC conservation partners organisations operating in Greater Virunga Landscape

The overall objective of the CGV programme is “Sustainable conservation of the Greater Virunga Landscape, through transboundary collaboration between the Democratic Republic of Congo, Rwanda and Uganda”. The overall objective is derived from the mandate of GVTC as given in the Treaty and reflects the GVTC Vision “The Greater Virunga Landscape sustainably conserved” and Mission “Enhancing sustainable conservation of the Protected Areas in Greater Virunga Landscape through improved Transboundary collaboration” as described in the Transboundary Strategic Plan (TSP) 2018-2023.

There are three intermediary objectives that the programme aims to achieve: Intermediary Objective 1: Coordinate and promote conservation of biodiversity within the GVL Intermediary Objective 2: Promote collaboration and coordination of Natural resource based socio-economic development in the GVL Intermediary Objective 3: Create conditions for sustainable transboundary collaboration on conservation and tourism

activity-date.narrative: The end of the four year CGV program is planned for December 2024

This annual report presents the activities of the Greater Virunga Transboundary Collaboration (GVTC) implemented from January 2023 to December 2023 using funds from the Embassy of the Kingdom of Netherlands (EKN) in Kigali. The EKN funded the four year project “Conserving Greater Virunga (CGV)” since December 2020 when the cooperation arrangement between the Minister of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation of the Netherlands and the Greater Virunga Transboundary Collaboration (GVTC) was signed. The CGV project providing the primary funding for GVTC work contributes to the broad peacebuilding and conflict resolution of the EKN program in this region. Under the cooperation arrangement GVTC implements the CGV program promoting collaboration among the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), the Republic of Uganda and the Republic of Rwanda in management of protected areas that straddles their boundaries in the Greater Virunga Landscape (GVL).
